entries.reason: Geometry-collection bones bind to World3D bodies only through PhysicsLink; either destruction order must stale-resolve without retained Body3D pointers.
entries.create: GeometryCollectionInstance::create builds Body3D per bone and stores PhysicsLink::fromBody; rollback destroys partial bodies on failure.
entries.ownership: Instance owns bodies it creates; World3D owns the solver registry; Asset remains the immutable geometry/connection authority; GeometryCollectionRenderer borrows Instance/Graphics only for the call.
entries.destroy_order: Instance-first destroys owned bodies then clears links; World-first makes findWorld/resolve return StaleHandle and step/applyField/draw reject without mutating topology.
entries.restore: Process-local links are not persistent; restore/hot-reload must recreate Instance against a restored World3D from asset identity; presentation rebuilds from bonePresentation + sleepBatchRevision.
entries.stale: boneLink/step/applyField/bonePresentation/draw resolve World3D::findWorld and PhysicsLink::resolve; encoded link validity alone is insufficient.

entries.reason: Physics links are process-local projections and must be stale-safe across either destruction order and restore.
evidence: docs/dev/物理系统分层与后端契约.md
entries.ownership: World owns bodies, shapes and joints; gameplay stores only the typed link projection.
entries.destroy_order: Shape/Joint before Body/World and World before dependants both invalidate to StaleHandle.
entries.restore: Rebuild process-local links from persistent identity after transactional world restore or hot reload.
entries.stale: Generation and owner identity are checked by resolve; encoded validity alone is insufficient.

entries.reason: Bone-bound trajectory sweeps borrow World3D and IAttachmentPointSource; either destruction order must stale-fail without retained Body3D pointers.
entries.create: TrajectoryCollisionRuntime observes World3D via weak lifetime token and runtimeHandle; arm samples IAttachmentPointSource before storing previous==current.
entries.ownership: World3D solely owns bodies and shapes; the runtime owns catalog/armed/hit-memory state and publishes process-local body/shape handles on hits only.
entries.destroy_order: Runtime-first drops borrowed world/pose pointers without mutating World3D; world-first makes liveWorld null and advance/arm return StaleHandle.
entries.restore: Process-local handles and armed samples are not persistent; callers rebind pose sources and re-arm colliders after world restore or hot reload.
entries.stale: advance/arm resolve lifetimeToken plus runtimeHandle equality before any cast; pose sources are cleared with clearPoseSource before subject teardown.
